description: NaYS₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent YS₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent YS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 5°. All Na-S bond lengths are 2.91 Å. Y³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent S²⁻ atoms to form YS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent YS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 5°. All Y-S bond lengths are 2.75 Å. S²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Y³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SNa₃Y₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
